# CI/CD Status Badges

Add these badges to your README.md to show the status of your workflows:

## Copy-Paste Ready (for README.md)

Add this to the top of your README.md, right after the title:

```markdown
# LiteLLM Proxy with LangFuse Integration

[![CI Pipeline](https://github.com/MueMike/llm-scope/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MueMike/llm-scope/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Security Scanning](https://github.com/MueMike/llm-scope/actions/workflows/security.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MueMike/llm-scope/actions/workflows/security.yml)
[![Release](https://github.com/MueMike/llm-scope/actions/workflows/release.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MueMike/llm-scope/actions/workflows/release.yml)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/MueMike/llm-scope/branch/main/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/MueMike/llm-scope)
[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/MueMike/llm-scope)](https://github.com/MueMike/llm-scope/releases)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/MueMike/llm-scope)](LICENSE)
[![Python Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.11%2B-blue)](https://www.python.org/downloads/)

A production-ready LiteLLM proxy server with integrated LangFuse tracing...
```
